leaves.name: eichlerOptEmbCount6
leaves.doc: gr56-prove, printed form (pure algebra): Eichler's theorem on optimal embeddings for the maximal order O of the quaternion algebra (2,-3) of discriminant 6 (class number one): for an order R of conductor prime to 6 in an imaginary quadratic k, the O^x-classes of optimal embeddings R -> O are finite in number, h(R) * prod_{p|6} (1 - (k/p)). Replaces gonzalezRotgerProp56X6 with qmTorusAbelian and the added-bundle LEAF shimuraTaniyamaQbar (the CM-point map is a bijection, GR56.cmPointsOptEmb6_of_st).
leaves.source: Eichler, J. reine angew. Math. 195 (1955); Vigneras, Arithmetique des algebres de quaternions, LNM 800 (1980), Ch. III Thm 5.11, Cor. 5.12; Voight, Quaternion Algebras (2021), Thm 30.7.3 (numbers UNVERIFIED); at the maximal order of (2,-3) (class number one), counted modulo O^x

leaves.name: qmTorusAbelian
leaves.doc: gr56-prove, printed form: for tau in the upper half plane the QM torus C^2/iota(O)(tau,1) is the analytic space of an abelian surface with QM by O (analytic uniformization with kernel qmLattice tau, iota-compatible).
leaves.flag: locator UNVERIFIED (Shimura 1963 sections 2-4; algebraization by Riemann/Chow/GAGA)
leaves.source: Shimura, Ann. of Math. 78 (1963), sections 2-4 (QM tori by a maximal order of an indefinite quaternion algebra are abelian varieties); Birkenhake-Lange, Complex abelian varieties (2004), Ch. 9; algebraization: Riemann's theorem with GAGA (Serre 1956) (numbers UNVERIFIED)
